title: Verify security answers request body
description: Checks the caller's answers against the user's enrolled security questions; verification passes when at least 2 of 3 answers are correct. Do not wrap these fields in a request_body property; this schema describes the raw JSON body.

user_id.description: ServiceNow sys_user.sys_id returned by lookup_user_record. Do not generate or infer this value.

questions_answers.description: Exactly 3 entries, one per question returned by get_security_questions, each with the caller's answer.

question_id.description: pwd_active_question.sys_id returned as questions[].sys_id by get_security_questions. Do not generate or infer this value.

user_answer.description: The caller's answer exactly as stated. Leading and trailing spaces are trimmed. Never repeat, log, or store this value elsewhere.
